crossRefs.note: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
For Yahweh says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called…
The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in…

translations.web: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
translations.bsb: He scorns the tumult of the city and never hears the shouts of a driver.
translations.kjv: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
translations.asv: He scorneth the tumult of the city, Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.
